channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound tests 1.3500 as US Dollar struggles to shake off NFP shock
item.description: GBP/USD trades around 1.3495 on Monday at the time of writing, up a modest 0.04% on the day. However, the pair struggles to hold firmly above the psychological 1.3500 level after benefiting on Friday from a decline in the US Dollar (USD) triggered by disappointing United States (US) employment data.

item.title: Norwegian Krone: Policy hold guidance in focus – Nomura
item.description: Nomura’s Josie Anderson, George Buckley and Andrzej Szczepaniak expect Norges Bank to keep its policy rate at 4.25% at the August meeting, citing softer underlying inflation and benign domestic data.

item.title: CEE FX: Data-heavy week under global pressure – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky highlights a busy Central and Eastern Europe calendar with Czech inflation, Turkey’s inflation report and key Polish data, including GDP and core inflation.

item.title: Euro: Fed repricing supports gains against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists highlight that EUR/USD has squeezed above key resistance as Dollar weakness follows softer United States (US) employment data and reduced odds of a September Fed hike. The pair is seen slightly expensive versus nat gas but near fair value on 2-year spreads.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Hawkish RBA hold supports carry – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad notes that the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains one of the most attractive G10 currencies thanks to favorable carry and a hawkish Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.24 per troy ounce, up 1.08% from the $63.55 it cost on Friday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Recovery against US Dollar faces tariff risks – Commerzbank
item.description: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank highlights a strong Canadian labour market and improving Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) and exports as signs of real-economy recovery, but warns this is fragile due to threatened US tariffs.

item.title: Brent: Iran talks keep risk premium in focus – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that negotiations between Iran and Oman over a new shipping framework through the Strait of Hormuz remain finely balanced, with Tehran linking any lasting arrangement to broader demands on the US.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar stalls below 0.5900 as US Dollar regains safe-haven appeal
item.description: NZD/USD trades around 0.5895 on Monday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day.

item.title: Romanian Leu: Rating relief but NBR stays cautious – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky says Romania’s unchanged Baa3 rating at Moody’s and prior Fitch decision should ease pressure after recent ROMGBs underperformance.

item.title: Euro advances against Canadian Dollar as Eurozone Investor Confidence rises in August
item.description: EUR/CAD inches higher after three days of losses, trading around 1.6120 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross is holding its ground, driven primarily by a resilient Euro (EUR) following positive Eurozone economic sentiment.

item.title: Euro holds gains near seven-week highs as economic sentiment improves
item.description: The Euro (EUR) ticks higher against a softer US Dollar (USD) on Monday, with the EUR/USD pair trading at the 1.1560 area at the time of writing, consolidating gains a few pips below seven-week highs at 1.1773.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Struggles below 0.8100 as bears eye 50-SMA pivotal support
item.description: The USD/CHF pair struggles to attract any meaningful buyers and remains on the back foot below the 0.8100 mark through the first half of the European session on Monday.

item.title: Indian Rupee drops as Iran sets new Hormuz reopening conditions
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) is down against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 95.25 as oil prices extend their recovery move and the US Dollar regains ground after a weak Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention faces persistent rate gap – HSBC
item.description: HSBC Asset Management reviews recent coordinated intervention by Japanese and US authorities to support the Japanese Yen, recalling the sharp carry-trade unwind during the previous episode two years ago.

item.title: WTI comes off from day’s high as investors seeks clarity on Hormuz reopening
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, gives back some of its early gains, but it still 1.6% higher at around $77.55 during the European trading session on Monday. The oil price retreats from its day’s high as fears of a prolonged global energy supply disruption have escalated.

item.title: US Dollar: Softer labour data shifts Fed outlook – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux reports that weaker US employment data and downward revisions have sharply reduced expectations for a September Fed hike, though one move remains priced for December.

item.title: Eurozone Sentix Investor Confidence turns positive to 0.9 in August
item.description: Eurozone’s Sentix Investor Confidence data, a key indicator of Investor morale, turns positive to 0.9 in August, the first time in five months. The sentiment data turned negative in March when the Middle East war started. The data also improved to -3.1 in July.

item.title: Dow futures remain steady amid rising oil, diminishing Fed cut odds
item.description: Dow Jones futures are steady around 54,150 during European hours on Monday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures gain 0.16% to trade near 7,790 and Nasdaq 100 futures gain 0.39%, trading near 29,950.

item.title: Gold bulls seem hesitant near $4,350 as Iran risks and Fed hike bets support USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) climbs above $4,350, hitting a fresh high during the first half of the European session on Monday, though it remains below the highest level since June 17, set on Friday in reaction to the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA set to hold amid inflation risks - BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu and David Tam expect the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) to keep rates unchanged at 4.35%, noting that markets doubt its willingness to hike despite persistent inflation and robust labor and spending data.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD confirms a bullish H&S targeting $67.17
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) appreciates for the second consecutive day on Monday, trading around $64.30 after confirming above July’s peak in the $63.30 area.

item.title: British Pound rallies to over one-week high as fiscal woes and rate gap hammer Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross catches aggressive bids at the start of a new week and builds on its strong recovery move from the vicinity of mid-209.00s, or the lowest level since early March touched last Monday.

item.title: Swedish Krona: Hormuz reopening could lift SEK against NOK - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister analyses NOK/SEK through oil-price sensitivity and rate expectations. He finds the Norwegian Krone reacts more strongly to oil than the Swedish Krona, while Riksbank expectations adjust more to oil shocks than Norges Bank.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Decline to accelerate below 99.40
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) edges up against its peers on Monday after a vertical decline on Friday. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades marginally higher to near 99.70.

item.title: Brent: Cautious trade with geopolitical risks – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Bas van Geffen notes that talks on reopening Hormuz are progressing slowly, with Iran adding new conditions on the United States (US), keeping geopolitical risk elevated for Oil.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Positions above nine-day EMA near 183.00
item.description: EUR/JPY rises after registering losses in the previous day, trading around 183.10 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross is holding a capped tone as it sits below the 50-day Exponential moving average (EMA) while clinging to short-term support at the nine-day EMA.

item.title: British Pound: Soft GDP could trigger dovish BoE repricing – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad argues that the British Pound (GBP) requires a stronger-than-expected United Kingdom (UK) Gross Domestic Product (GDP) print to gain upside traction.

item.title: Australian Dollar flat above 0.7050 vs USD, close to June 16 peak as traders await RBA
item.description: The AUD/USD pair enters a bullish consolidation phase at the start of the new week as traders opt to move to the sidelines ahead of the crucial Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) meeting on Tuesday.

item.title: Equities: Falling oil and AI rebound drive record highs - Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that falling energy prices and softer Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations helped push the S&P 500 and other major equity indices to new record highs last week.
